name: person-card
title: Person card
description: One person and what they are building: the name, the role, one line of work and one link. The card shows the person's initials, cut from their name by a pure core, instead of a photo; a photo belongs there only when the author writes it and the person's consent is recorded. Quiet is a hairline card with a plain disc; warm is a soft card with the initials in the hand; playful colours the disc from a seed and tilts the card a little when the pointer or the focus arrives.
